verdict.rationale: AFK claims to run parallel task graphs across multiple integrated tools (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe) and orchestrate many operational tasks concurrently, which implies bulk cross-item operations, but there's no explicit evidence of a user invoking a single command/action across many items simultaneously (e.g., bulk approve, bulk update). missing for 10: explicit bulk-action UI/API examples, independent/hands-on confirmation of scale, quantified throughput or item counts.
